mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN sales_order o ON o.user_id = u.id AND o.order_status IN ('Paid', 'Shipped', 'Completed')
mapper.select:
SELECT CASE WHEN cnt = 0 THEN '0 次' WHEN cnt = 1 THEN '1 次' WHEN cnt <= 3 THEN '2-3 次' WHEN cnt <= 6 THEN '4-6 次' WHEN cnt <= 10 THEN '7-10 次' ELSE '10 次以上' END AS band, COUNT(*) AS userCount FROM (SELECT u.id, COUNT(o.id) AS cnt FROM ecommerce_user u
GROUP BY u.id) t GROUP BY band ORDER BY MIN(cnt)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalUsers, COALESCE(SUM(cnt >= 1), 0) AS buyerUsers, COALESCE(SUM(cnt >= 2), 0) AS multiBuyerUsers, (SELECT MAX(paid_at) FROM sales_order WHERE order_status IN ('Paid', 'Shipped', 'Completed')) AS dataDate FROM (SELECT u.id, COUNT(o.id) AS cnt FROM ecommerce_user u
GROUP BY u.id) t

SELECT ROUND(AVG(span), 1) AS avgIntervalDays, COUNT(*) AS multiBuyerUsers FROM (SELECT u.id, DATEDIFF(MAX(o.ordered_at), MIN(o.ordered_at)) / NULLIF(COUNT(o.id) - 1, 0) AS span FROM ecommerce_user u JOIN sales_order o ON o.user_id = u.id AND o.order_status IN ('Paid', 'Shipped', 'Completed') GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(o.id) >= 2) t

SELECT fm.firstMonth AS firstMonth, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, fm.firstOrderAt, o.ordered_at) AS monthIndex, COUNT(DISTINCT fm.id) AS retentionUsers FROM (SELECT u.id, MIN(o.ordered_at) AS firstOrderAt, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(o.ordered_at), '%Y-%m') AS firstMonth FROM ecommerce_user u JOIN sales_order o ON o.user_id = u.id AND o.order_status IN ('Paid', 'Shipped', 'Completed') GROUP BY u.id) fm JOIN sales_order o ON o.user_id = fm.id AND o.order_status IN ('Paid', 'Shipped', 'Completed') GROUP BY fm.firstMonth, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, fm.firstOrderAt, o.ordered_at) ORDER BY fm.firstMonth, monthIndex

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.user_code AS userCode, COUNT(o.id) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(o.payment_amount), 0) AS amount, MAX(o.ordered_at) AS lastOrderAt FROM ecommerce_user u JOIN sales_order o ON o.user_id = u.id AND o.order_status IN ('Paid', 'Shipped', 'Completed') GROUP BY u.id, u.user_code ORDER BY orderCount DESC LIMIT 10
